COM.note: No link between civil register and ID stated.
Census only described as planned by INSEED with UNFPA support; no mapping, funding or date stated.
Only a preparatory study for digitisation is stated; no system procured, piloted or rolled out.

No ID system operation or ownership stated.
No register keyed on the ID number stated.

facts.fact: The AMECC II steering committee of 2 December 2025 discussed mobilising resources to finance the 2024-2028 strategic plan for civil registration modernisation, with the ANEC statutes decree finalised.
